comment.comment: A whole-line or trailing comment. A '#' inside a quoted value is handled by #string and never reaches here.
comment.name: comment.line.number-sign.paradox

entry.comment: A loc key, the ':' separator, and an optional version number directly after the colon (KEY:0). No leading whitespace is required.

string.comment: Paradox loc strings run to the LAST unescaped quote on the line, so an embedded '"' is data, not a terminator. The end anchor closes at a quote with no further quote after it (the last quote on the line); anything after that quote is outside the string and handled by #invalid. The trailing '$' only fires when the string is never closed on the line, which keeps an unclosed quote from eating the rest of the file.
string.name: string.quoted.double.paradox

loc-reference.comment: A reference to another loc key, e.g. $OTHER_KEY$.
loc-reference.name: variable.parameter.paradox

loc-icon.comment: An inline icon tag, e.g. £gold or £army_experience£ .
loc-icon.name: keyword.other.icon.paradox

invalid.comment: Stray unquoted text outside a quoted value is not valid loc. A loc value must be a quoted string, so any bare token left over (before, after, or instead of the string) is flagged. Runs stop at whitespace, '#' (a comment) and '"' (a string) so those keep their own scopes.
invalid.name: invalid.illegal.unquoted.paradox
